content: JISAS KAT PAILATNA NGAYAT KALINDI KOTMAK KAT
Yisola la nɨmba laataa Jisas kat kwutaa Pailat walɨnja njambwi nyana ngayat kalindi.

Kalilaa Pailat kat wandi. Ndɨ Juda kat kavle maawut kwilɨgandɨ. Njambwi nyan Sisa kat takis sanya ke kwiga waa walɨngandɨ. Sisa njambwi king ana ndɨ. Wun njambwi king, Kraist wun waa walɨgandɨ waa Pailat kat woseka wandi.
Wandi mala Pailat Jisas kat wagalandɨ. Mɨn Judana njambwi king mɨn waa wagalandɨ, Jisas wandɨ. Mɨn mɨnayɨ wupma waa.
Pailat God kat kwunatɨga njambwi nɨmbogwi nat nɨmba kat wandɨ. Jisas ndɨ kavle vat ana yindɨ. Vɨga lɨgowun waa wandɨ Pailat.
Wandɨ maa ndi nɨma kwundimba walega wandi. Kai Judana ngepma ngepma yiga kavle maawut ksilɨgandɨ. Galili laataa yiga kavle maawut kwiga kumba tɨna kavat yandɨ waa Pailat kat walega wandɨ.
JISAS KAT HEROTNA NGAYAT KALINDI KOTMAK KAT
Galili laataa waa walɨnja nyaangɨt wutaa Pailat ndi kat wagalandɨ. Ndɨ Galili nyana waa wagalandɨ, awa wandi.
Njambwi nyan Herot Galili nɨmba kat vɨga lɨgandɨ waa yelavɨtaa Jisas kat kwutaa Herotna ngayat kali ngwula waa wandɨ. Wan njimbla Herot Jerusalemba tɨndɨ. Sivla kavat ana kalindi.
Kalindi, Herot Jisas kat vɨlaa solat sɨlɨndɨ. Tak Jisas kwuta nɨma njɨvwa wutndɨ. Ndɨ kat vivat woviyaguga lɨndɨ. Jisas kwuta nɨma njɨvwa kɨta Herot vɨvat woviyaguga tɨndɨ.
Ndɨ Jisas kat nɨma sakwat nyaangɨt wagalandɨ. Jisas ndɨ kat ana awat wandɨ.
God kat kwunatɨga njambwi nɨmbogwi Moses kwiya nyaanɨt sɨmogwi la nɨmbo laataa nɨma kwundimba Jisas kat kavle nyaangɨt ngambundi.
Herotnogwi ndɨna soldia dino Jisas kat njɨtɨndi. Njambwi nɨmba kwusolɨnja apma waavwi ndɨ kat kasega kwusondi. Kwusolaa Pailatnat kalindi.
Tamba Pailatnogwio Herotnogwi walaa lɨmbɨk. Wan nandinya kɨmbɨk kwupmbɨk.
JISAS KAT DIWAI KROSMBA KAALAGIYANGWUK WAA WANDƗ PAILAT
Pailat wandɨ maa God kat kwunatɨga njambwi nɨmba, Judana nat njambwi nɨmba, nat nɨmba yaa yisolaa lɨndi.
Yandi maa Pailat ndi kat wandɨ. Wan nyan Juda kat kavle maawut kwilɨgandɨ waa walaa wun kat kiyangwuk. Ndɨ kat wagalalaa wangwa vat kavle yinda vat ana vɨga lɨgowun. Ndɨ kavle vat ana yindɨ.
Wowun maa Herotnat kalingwuk Herot ndɨno kavle vat yinda vat ana vɨga lɨndɨ. Ndɨ kavle vat and yindɨ. Ndɨ kat manda kat vatnyavat wangwuk. Ana nglaatndɨ.
Ngi kat tɨga ndɨ kat viyalaa kwagalgiyowun waa wandɨ Pailat.
Kan Pailatna vatna naambi naambi pestona njɨmbla kalabusmba la kɨta nyan kat kwagalalɨndɨ.
Kwagalgiyowun waa wandɨ maa ndi wandi. Kai ndɨ kat ke kwagalaga. Nat nyan Barabas ndɨ kat kwagala mɨla waa wandi.
Wan nyan Barabas tamba gavman kat kao yilɨndɨ. Kao yiga lɨga kɨta nyan kat vatnyandɨ, kalabusmba ndɨ kat taagandi.
Wandi maa Pailat Jisas kat kwagalavat ndi kat nat njambɨ wandɨ.
Ndi walega wandi. Diwai krosmba ndɨ kat kaala. Diwai krosmba ndɨ kat kaala waa walega wandi.

Pailat laataa ndi kat kuvut wan njambɨ wandɨ. Kavle vat yinda vat anda vatna. Kavle vat yinda vat ana vɨga lɨgowun. Ndɨ kavle vat ana yindɨ. Ndɨ kat manda kat vatnyagiyowun. Ndɨ kat viyalaa kwagalagiyowun waa wandɨ maa
ndi nɨma kwundimba walega walɨndi. Ndɨ kat diwai krosmba kaala waa walɨndi. God kat kwunata njambwi nɨmbogwi nat nɨmba walega walɨnja vat Pailat kat kwulatndi.
Ndɨ kat kalilaa ngwutna maawupmba vatnyagiyangwuk waa Pailat wandɨ.
Tamba gavman kat kao lɨga nat nyan kat vatnya la nyan kalabusmba tɨga nyan Pailat wandɨ maa ndɨ kat kwagalandi. Juda wandi maa ndɨ kat kwagalandi. Jisas ndi kat kwindɨ.
JISAS KAT DIWAI KROSMBA KAALANDI

Jisas kat kwutaa kaliga nat kɨta nyan kat vɨndi. Ndɨna sɨ Saimon. Ndɨna ngepmamba lɨga Jerusalemat yalɨndɨ, vɨndi. Ndɨ kat kwutaa kiwai kros ndɨna nyambupmba taagandi, walalaa kalindɨ. Ndɨ Jisasna kwupmba yiga walalaa kalindɨ.
Nɨma sakwat nɨmba ndu lagwa ndɨna kwupmba yiga nglalɨndi.
Jisas lungwamaka taagwa kat vɨga wandɨ. Judana taagwa ngwuk wun kat ke ngla lɨngwa. Ngwuk avla angla ngwula. Ngwutna nyangu kat angla ngwula.
Ngɨni yaiga kavle njɨmbla kupma waigandi. Nyan kwutapman taagwa, nyan mwunya kwilapman taagwa apma vat tɨgandi waa ngɨni waigandi.
Ngɨni yaiga kavle njɨmbla njduwi kat waigandɨ. Nɨn kat ndaiga tegɨlɨndɨ, wundumba yigiyanɨn. Mat nduwi kat waigandi. Nɨn kat kapmandɨ, pakwulaa apma vat tɨgiyanɨn waa waigandi.

Wun kavle vat ana yiwun. Mbambala wun kat nɨma vat yilɨgandi. Ngwuk kavle vat yilɨngangwuk Ngɨni ngwuk kat nɨma vat yigiyandi. Ngwuk kat yinjeya nɨma vat nɨmana. Mbambala wun kat yilɨnja nɨma vak matna waa wandɨ Jisas.
Jisasogwinala kavle vat ykla mbɨt nyan kalindi. Mbɨk kat vatnyavat kalindi.
Nambu ava walɨnja kava yalaa Jisas kat diwai krosmba kaalandi. Kavle vat yila mbɨt nyan mbɨk kat angangɨmba kaalandi, lɨmbɨt.
Kaalandi maa Jisas God kat wandɨ. Nyaek wun kat kavle vat yilɨnja vak kwagala mɨla. Ndina maawut ana yelavɨka lɨgandi waa wandɨ. Nat nɨmba satu kasega kwulata nyan Jisasna waavwi klandɨ.

Nɨma sakwat nɨmba yisoga vɨlɨndi. Judana njambwi nɨmba ndino vɨlɨndi. Vɨga kasega walɨndi. Jisas nat nɨmba kat kwunapmat tɨndɨ. Mbambala manda kat avla ndɨna mbangɨ ana kwunatɨgandɨ. Ndɨ God wandɨ, yaa nyan ana ndɨ. Ndɨ Kraist ana ndɨ waa kasega walɨndi.
Soldia ndino kasendi. Kavle njangu veilɨga ngu Jisas kɨnda kat kwilɨndi.
Kwiga walɨndi. Mɨn Judana king ana mɨn waa kasega wandi.
Diwai krosmba nyaangɨt pɨlɨwutaa taagandi. Ndɨ Judana kinga waa pɨlɨwutaa taagandi.
Kavle vat yila mbɨt nyana kɨta nyan diwai krosmba lɨga Jisas kat kasega wandɨ. Mɨn Kraist tɨgeman avla mɨna mbangɨ kwunataa an kat kwunakemɨn waa kasega wandɨ.
Nat naangɨmba la nyan ndɨ kat kai walaa wandɨ. Manda kat wupma walɨgamɨn God kat ana vaaka lɨgamɨn? Mɨn ana kiyaigamɨn?
Kavle vat yiliangat vatnyagiyandi. Ndɨ wupma kai. Ndɨ kavle vat ana yindɨ waa nat nyan kat walaa Jisas kat wandɨ.
Njambwi nyan kingat tɨmeya njɨmbla wunkat maawut ke tɨvɨga waa wandɨ maa Jisas ndɨ kat wandɨ.
Mɨn kat woseka ana wowun. Mbambala wunogwinala nyinangwupmba tɨgiyamɨn waa wandɨ.
JISAS LAMBA WUNDUMBU YINDƗ
Nya nɨndi nambɨtɨ, kulun wandɨ. Kulun walaa tɨga lɨga 3 klok nglaambu ngɨlɨndɨ, nya sɨndɨ.
Kulun wandɨ, Godna ngay njambia la kava tɨvɨnda nɨma waavwi avla ngɨlɨtndɨ.
Jisas nɨma kwundimba walega wandɨ. Nyaek wowun mala wuna wundumbu mɨnai lɨga kavat yigandɨ waa walaa wundumbu yindɨ.
Vɨga la njambwi soldia kiyanda vak vɨlaa Godna sɨ kwutaa katsolaa wandɨ. Wan nyan kavle nyan ana ndɨ. Apma vat yeta nyana waa wandɨ.
Yalaa va nɨmba vɨlaa kavle vat yindi wandi. Ndina maawut viyalɨndɨ, yindi.
Jisasna alɨ nɨmbogwi Galilimba lɨga ndɨna kwupmba ya tagwo sɨvlamba laataa lɨga vɨlɨndi.
JISASNA SƗM WAANGUMBA TAAGANDI
Judana njambwi nyan kɨta lɨndɨ. Ndɨna sɨ Josep. Ndɨ apma nyana. Ndɨ God waa nyaangɨpmba yetɨlɨga nyana.
Tat Judana njambwi nɨmba yisolaa Jisas kat vatnyagiyamɨn waa wanja njɨmbla ndɨ kat kai wandɨ. Ndɨna ngepma Arimatia. Ndɨ God ndinyangu kat vɨga lɨndeya njɨmbla kat kawiga lɨndɨ.
Wan nyan Pailat ta ngay wuleilaa Jisasna sɨm kat wagalandɨ.
Ndɨ wokelaa kwutaa klanda kalɨndɨ kɨpmat. Klanda kalilaa waavwimba mbaataa kaliga kambapmba vanja waangumba taagandɨ. Kan waangumba tak ndu nyana sɨm ana taagandi. Kupi waangua.
Ndɨna sɨm waangumba taaganda nandinya njɨvwa lapman nandinya kat kwanda kwanda kwunatɨnja nandinya.
Galilimba lɨga Jisasna kwupmba yaa taagwa Josepna kwupmba yiga taaganda waangu vɨndi.
Vɨlaa lungwamataa yindi. Ndɨna sɨmba salapmat apma njangu weilɨga ngwaat klavat yindi. Yilaa nat nandinya ana yandi. Njɨvwa lapman nandinya. Ndi kwo lɨndi. Tamba Moses kwiya nyaangɨpmba kwo lɨndi.
